- What is double-time pay.

## How do I calculate my overtime pay?
`Double time pay = standard rate × 2 × number of hours`

## What is double-time pay?
An employer may opt to pay double when an employee has worked more than the typical 40-hour week or for work done on weekends or holidays.

## FAQs
### What is the double time rate if my standard rate is 20 dollars per hour?
**$40**

To calculate your double-time rate, multiply your standard pay rate by 2.

So using this process `$20 * 2 = $40`.
